test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An Indian Parliamentary delegation led by Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, Coal and Mines ________________ visited Brazil from 11 to 13 June 2023.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Prahlad Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prahlad Joshi** is the current **Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, Coal, and Mines** in the Government of India.
 
• He has been a Member of Parliament (MP) since **2004**, representing the **Dharwad constituency** in Karnataka.
 
• Known for his extensive work in the **Parliamentary Affairs Ministry**, he plays a key role in ensuring the smooth functioning of parliamentary sessions.
 
• Under his leadership, the Indian Parliamentary delegation visited **Brazil** from **11 to 13 June 2023**, strengthening diplomatic ties and inter-parliamentary relations between the two nations.
 
• He has significantly contributed to the development of the **coal and mining sectors** in India, focusing on sustainable practices and increasing production efficiency.
 
• The visit to Brazil highlighted India's commitment to **international parliamentary cooperation** and fostering global partnerships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Virendra Kumar**__

 __
 
• **Virendra Kumar** is the Minister of **Social Justice and Empowerment** in the Government of India.
 
• He has been actively involved in policies related to the welfare of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other disadvantaged groups in India.
 
 
 
• **Narayan Rane**__
 __
 
• **Narayan Rane** serves as the Minister of **Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)** in the Government of India.
 
• He focuses on promoting entrepreneurship and supporting small-scale industries in the country.
 
 
 
• **Arjun Munda**__
 
 
• **Arjun Munda** is the Minister of **Tribal Affairs** in the Government of India.
 
• He works on the upliftment and development of tribal communities across the nation.
